import numpy as np

# HumanEval pass@1 rates (%) for CodeLlama and GPT-4
languages = ['Python', 'JavaScript', 'Java', 'C++', 'Rust']
codellama_scores = [62.3, 55.8, 51.2, 48.7, 31.4]
gpt4_scores = [87.1, 79.4, 74.6, 72.1, 58.3]

# Set up the figure and axis
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 7), frameon=False)

# Line positions

# Create line plots for CodeLlama and GPT-4
ax.plot(x, codellama_scores, marker='o', linewidth=2.5, markersize=10,
        label='CodeLlama', color='#1f77b4')
ax.plot(x, gpt4_scores, marker='o', linewidth=2.5, markersize=10,
        label='GPT-4', color='#ff7f0e')

# Add value labels on each data point

    # GPT-4 label

                xy=(i, g4),
                xytext=(0, 8),
                textcoords="offset points",
                ha='center', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold', color='#ff7f0e')

# Adjust layout and save

print("Plot saved as 'codegen_comparison.png'")

print("\n" + "="*60)
print("HUMANEVAL PASS@1 RATE SUMMARY")
print("="*60)
print(f"{'Language':<15} {'CodeLlama':>12} {'GPT-4':>12} {'Gap':>10}")
print("-"*60)

print("="*60)
